regions.merged_text: God bless you and yours. Inclosed herewith I am sending you the ticket of which I spoke to you yesterday when I asked for Judge Maher. In a way I was pleased rather that you answered. I've been imposing on the good nature of both Judge Monahan and Judge Murphy that they are liable to throw me out some of these days with my unfortunate friends .. Trusting that they still have a heart, I hope you'll be able to take care of us this time too. .... God bless the court and all concerned.
